meta.title: Tikpal Intelligence — Your world, understood
meta.description: Tikpal Intelligence understands the people, projects, ideas, decisions, commitments and next steps behind your voice notes — so every new thought starts with context, not from zero.

closingLine: Intelligence that moves with life — and understands your world.

hero.headline: Your world, understood.
hero.subtitle: Every moment adds context. Tikpal understands the people, projects, ideas, decisions, commitments — and what comes next.

belong.title: It knows what belongs together.
belong.valueLine: You don't start from zero every time.

life.quote: Mom's birthday is next Friday. She liked that little Italian place we went to last year. I told Dad I'd book a table for four and pick up the cake.

followup.question: What do I still need to do for Mom's birthday?
followup.answer: You still need to book the table and pick up the cake. The dinner is next Friday.

evolve.title: It remembers how things evolve.
evolve.closing: Not a pile of old recordings — the path from idea to outcome.

ask.title: Ask naturally. Act on it.
